ns2:course.label: Mergers and Acquisition
ns2:course.description: Focuses on identifying ways to increase firm value through mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and corporate restructurings. Surveys the drivers of success (failure) in M&A transactions and develop your skills in the design and evaluation of transactions. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FIN 321.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FIN 321.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
